items_flat.title_en: SpaceXAI launches Grok 4.7 for coding and knowledge work
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceXAI 推出 Grok 4.7，鎖定編程與知識工作
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI announced Grok 4.7 on September 21 as its most capable model for coding and knowledge work, using a larger base than Grok 4.6 plus a longer RL run on multi-hour tasks, stronger self-checking, and native Grok Bot harness training. It keeps Grok 4.6 pricing at $2/$6 per million tokens and is live in Cursor, Grok Build, and the Grok API.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 於 9 月 21 日宣布 Grok 4.7，稱其為目前最強的編程與知識工作模型：比 4.6 更大的基座、更長的多小時任務強化學習、更強自我核對，並原生訓練 Grok Bot 工具鏈。價格維持每百萬 token $2/$6，已上線 Cursor、Grok Build 與 Grok API。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a same-price capability step, not a new pricing war: SpaceXAI is competing on long-horizon coding and office work while keeping 4.6 economics. Independent leaderboards and third-party harness results still need to confirm the published bench table.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是同價能力升級，而非新一輪價格戰：SpaceXAI 以長程編程與辦公任務競爭，同時維持 4.6 經濟模型。官方榜單尚待獨立排行榜與第三方工具鏈驗證。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.7 is our most capable model for coding and knowledge work. It works longer on difficult tasks, checks its own work more carefully, and comes with our best-calibrated safeguards to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 是我們目前最強的編程與知識工作模型。它能在困難任務上工作更久、更仔細核對自己的產出，並配備迄今校準最好的安全機制。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI partners with an independent math advisory group at IAS
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與普林斯頓高等研究院獨立數學顧問團合作
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is working with an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence hosted at the Institute for Advanced Study to review how mathematical results are assessed and communicated. Initial members include Timothy Gowers, Martin Hairer, Edward Witten and Melanie Matchett Wood; OpenAI says members are unpaid and the group may publish advice independently.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布與設於普林斯頓高等研究院的「數學與人工智慧顧問團」合作，就數學成果的評估與對外溝通提供意見。初始成員包括 Timothy Gowers、Martin Hairer、Edward Witten 與 Melanie Matchett Wood；OpenAI 稱成員不支薪，且可獨立公開建議。
items_flat.analysis_en: The institutional move is real; any claim that an internal model solved a large set of open problems remains a company assertion pending community review. The group’s brief is communication standards, not pacing OpenAI’s internal math research.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 制度安排屬實；內部模型已解決大量未解問題的說法仍是公司主張，有待學界審視。顧問團職權是溝通標準，而非決定 OpenAI 內部數學研究節奏。
items_flat.quote: The group will operate independently from OpenAI. The group will have the freedom to offer advice we have not requested, comment on OpenAI’s impact on mathematics, and make its advice public.
items_flat.quote_zh: 該小組將獨立於 OpenAI 運作，可主動提供未被要求的建議、評論 OpenAI 對數學的影響，並公開其意見。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Anthropic urge Australia to ease AI training copyright ban
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 Anthropic 籲澳洲放寬 AI 訓練著作權禁令
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters reported on September 22 that OpenAI and Anthropic, in submissions to an Australian parliamentary AI inquiry, asked Canberra to relax a ban on using local creative works for model training. Anthropic proposed a narrow conditional approval tied to investment in Australian creators; OpenAI called for a balanced framework that lets models learn from publicly available information while offering rightsholder collaboration. Australia has already ruled out a broad copyright exemption; a committee report is due in November.
items_flat.summary_zh: 路透 9 月 22 日報導，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 向澳洲國會 AI 調查提交意見，要求重新考慮禁止以本國創作品訓練模型的規定。Anthropic 主張有條件、範圍較窄的許可並可搭配對澳洲創作者的投資；OpenAI 則要求讓模型學習公開資訊、同時提供權利人合作機會。澳政府已排除全面著作權例外，委員會報告預計 11 月出爐。
items_flat.analysis_en: The submissions link copyright settings to data-centre investment already announced in Sydney and Queensland. They are lobbying texts, not a policy change; the government has already rejected a broad training exception.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 兩家公司把著作權規則與已宣布的雪梨、昆士蘭資料中心投資綁在一起。這是遊說文件而非政策轉向；澳府已否決寬鬆訓練例外。
items_flat.quote: As an alternative, we believe that the government could permit AI model training through a narrow form of conditional approval.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為替代方案，我們認為政府可以透過一種範圍較窄的有條件核准，允許 AI 模型訓練。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Anthropic weighed a mutual commercial-model stress-test deal
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 Anthropic 曾研議互相壓力測試商用模型
items_flat.summary_en: The Information reported, and outlets republished into September 22, that OpenAI and Anthropic discussed a legally binding arrangement giving each API access to the other’s commercially available models to hunt vulnerabilities, with a no-retention rule and unreleased systems excluded. It is not clear whether the pact was signed.
items_flat.summary_zh: 《The Information》報導、並於 9 月 22 日持續被轉述：OpenAI 與 Anthropic 曾討論具法律約束力的安排，互相取得對方「已上市商用模型」的 API 以查找弱點，約定不保留對方資料，未發布系統不在範圍內。協議是否簽署仍不明。
items_flat.analysis_en: Peer API testing would be a notable governance experiment if completed, but the story is still a leak about talks, not an official joint announcement. Exclusion of unreleased models limits how much it would constrain the frontier.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若真簽成，同業 API 互測會是值得注意的治理實驗；目前仍是談判外洩而非雙方官方宣布。未發布模型被排除，對最前沿系統的約束有限。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA launches DSX Ready to qualify AI-factory power and cooling gear
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 推出 DSX Ready，認證 AI 工廠電力與冷卻設備
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA announced DSX Ready on September 21, a qualification program for partner products that meet DSX AI-factory reference requirements, starting with battery energy storage systems and cooling distribution units. Initial BESS names are Hitachi Energy, LG Energy Solution and Tesla; initial CDU names are LG Electronics, LiquidStack and Vertiv.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 於 9 月 21 日宣布 DSX Ready，認證符合 DSX AI 工廠參考設計的夥伴產品，先從電池儲能系統與冷卻分配單元開始。首批 BESS 為 Hitachi Energy、LG Energy Solution 與 Tesla；首批 CDU 為 LG Electronics、LiquidStack 與 Vertiv。
items_flat.analysis_en: The constraint for frontier training is increasingly site power and cooling, not only GPUs. DSX Ready is a vendor-alignment program; it does not itself add compute capacity.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 前沿訓練的瓶頸愈來愈是場址電力與冷卻，而不只是 GPU。DSX Ready 是供應商對齊計畫，本身不增加算力。
items_flat.quote: To help builders make those decisions, NVIDIA is introducing NVIDIA DSX Ready, a qualification program for partner products and solutions that meet applicable NVIDIA DSX AI factory reference design requirements.
items_flat.quote_zh: 為協助建置方做決策，NVIDIA 推出 DSX Ready，認證符合 NVIDIA DSX AI 工廠參考設計要求的夥伴產品與方案。

items_flat.title_en: HackerOne to embed Anthropic Mythos in exposure-management products
items_flat.title_zh: HackerOne 將把 Anthropic Mythos 嵌入曝險管理產品
items_flat.summary_en: HackerOne said on September 21 it will integrate Anthropic’s Claude Mythos into selected H1 Platform products, starting with H1 Code Security Audit and H1 Code, to connect agentic vulnerability discovery with validation and remediation.
items_flat.summary_zh: HackerOne 於 9 月 21 日表示，將把 Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos 整合進部分 H1 Platform 產品，先從 H1 Code Security Audit 與 H1 Code 開始，把代理式漏洞發現接到驗證與修復流程。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a partner distribution of Anthropic’s cyber-oriented model, not a new Claude launch. Whether Mythos findings reduce the backlog or mainly increase discovery volume is the open operational question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 資安導向模型的通路部署，不是新版 Claude 發表。Mythos 發現是減少待修堆積、或只是增加發現量，仍待實務驗證。
items_flat.quote: Frontier cyber AI will be available in select products in the H1 Platform to help enterprises uncover deeper risk and move from insight to action faster.
items_flat.quote_zh: 前沿網安 AI 將出現在部分 H1 平台產品中，協助企業挖出更深風險、更快從洞察走到行動。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands Academy with role-based learning paths
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴充 Academy，推出依角色區分的學習路徑
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI expanded OpenAI Academy with new courses for developers, leaders, educators, and college students, alongside Apply AI at Work. Paths cover Codex/API production work, adoption strategy, classroom use, and student workflows, with course assessments and badges.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 擴充 OpenAI Academy，新增開發者、主管、教育者與大學生課程，並與 Apply AI at Work 並行。路徑涵蓋 Codex/API 生產、導入策略、課堂使用與學生工作流，並附評量與徽章。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a deployment-and-skilling product, not a model release. It tightens OpenAI’s hold on how enterprises and schools standardize agent workflows around ChatGPT and Codex.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是部署與技能產品，不是模型發表。它強化 OpenAI 讓企業與學校把代理工作流標準化到 ChatGPT 與 Codex 上的影響力。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re expanding OpenAI Academy with new courses for developers, leaders, educators, and college students.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們擴充 OpenAI Academy，為開發者、主管、教育者與大學生推出新課程。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Finances adds Experian credit-score tracking
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT Finances 新增 Experian 信用分數追蹤
items_flat.summary_en: ChatGPT release notes for September 21 say U.S. Plus and Pro users can connect an Experian credit report and VantageScore 3.0 in Finances for monthly updates and monitoring alerts. The Experian link is separate from Plaid bank connections.
items_flat.summary_zh: ChatGPT 9 月 21 日更新說明指出，美國 Plus 與 Pro 用戶可在 Finances 連結 Experian 信用報告與 VantageScore 3.0，取得月度更新與監控警示。該連結與 Plaid 銀行連線分開。
items_flat.analysis_en: The consumer finance surface keeps deepening inside ChatGPT. Availability is U.S.-only and plan-gated; how insights are generated from bureau data is not independently audited in this note.
items_flat.analysis_zh: ChatGPT 消費金融介面持續加深。僅限美國且依方案開放；徵信資料如何生成洞察，此次說明並未提供獨立稽核細節。
items_flat.quote: You can now track your credit score in ChatGPT. Securely connect your Experian® credit report and VantageScore® 3.0 credit score to get personalized insights.
items_flat.quote_zh: 你現在可以在 ChatGPT 追蹤信用分數。安全連接 Experian 信用報告與 VantageScore 3.0，取得個人化洞察。

items_flat.title_en: Hg extends Anthropic partnership to deploy Claude agents across its portfolio
items_flat.title_zh: Hg 延長與 Anthropic 合作，向投資組合部署 Claude 代理
items_flat.summary_en: European software investor Hg said on September 21 it is extending a three-year Anthropic relationship so Hg Catalyst can deploy Claude agentic capabilities across portfolio companies. Hg cited more than 1,600 live AI projects and over $260 million of related EBITDA impact as internal figures.
items_flat.summary_zh: 歐洲軟體投資機構 Hg 於 9 月 21 日表示，將延長與 Anthropic 三年合作，讓 Hg Catalyst 把 Claude 代理能力部署到投資組合公司。Hg 自稱有超過 1,600 個進行中的 AI 專案，以及逾 2.6 億美元相關 EBITDA 影響（內部數字）。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is enterprise distribution of existing Claude agent features, not a model drop. The EBITDA figure is Hg’s internal budget claim, not an audited outcome.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有 Claude 代理功能的企業通路，不是新模型。EBITDA 數字是 Hg 內部主張，並非經審計成果。
items_flat.quote: Hg Catalyst and Anthropic will work more closely together on what it takes to make agentic AI deliver measurable results inside real businesses.
items_flat.quote_zh: Hg Catalyst 與 Anthropic 將更緊密合作，讓代理式 AI 在真實企業中交出可衡量成果。

frontier_other.title_en: OpenAI and Anthropic urge Australia to ease AI training copyright ban
frontier_other.title_zh: OpenAI 與 Anthropic 籲澳洲放寬 AI 訓練著作權禁令
frontier_other.summary_en: Reuters reported on September 22 that OpenAI and Anthropic, in submissions to an Australian parliamentary AI inquiry, asked Canberra to relax a ban on using local creative works for model training. Anthropic proposed a narrow conditional approval tied to investment in Australian creators; OpenAI called for a balanced framework that lets models learn from publicly available information while offering rightsholder collaboration. Australia has already ruled out a broad copyright exemption; a committee report is due in November.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 路透 9 月 22 日報導，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 向澳洲國會 AI 調查提交意見，要求重新考慮禁止以本國創作品訓練模型的規定。Anthropic 主張有條件、範圍較窄的許可並可搭配對澳洲創作者的投資；OpenAI 則要求讓模型學習公開資訊、同時提供權利人合作機會。澳政府已排除全面著作權例外，委員會報告預計 11 月出爐。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The submissions link copyright settings to data-centre investment already announced in Sydney and Queensland. They are lobbying texts, not a policy change; the government has already rejected a broad training exception.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 兩家公司把著作權規則與已宣布的雪梨、昆士蘭資料中心投資綁在一起。這是遊說文件而非政策轉向；澳府已否決寬鬆訓練例外。
frontier_other.quote: As an alternative, we believe that the government could permit AI model training through a narrow form of conditional approval.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 作為替代方案，我們認為政府可以透過一種範圍較窄的有條件核准，允許 AI 模型訓練。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA launches DSX Ready to qualify AI-factory power and cooling gear
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA 推出 DSX Ready，認證 AI 工廠電力與冷卻設備
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA announced DSX Ready on September 21, a qualification program for partner products that meet DSX AI-factory reference requirements, starting with battery energy storage systems and cooling distribution units. Initial BESS names are Hitachi Energy, LG Energy Solution and Tesla; initial CDU names are LG Electronics, LiquidStack and Vertiv.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA 於 9 月 21 日宣布 DSX Ready，認證符合 DSX AI 工廠參考設計的夥伴產品，先從電池儲能系統與冷卻分配單元開始。首批 BESS 為 Hitachi Energy、LG Energy Solution 與 Tesla；首批 CDU 為 LG Electronics、LiquidStack 與 Vertiv。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The constraint for frontier training is increasingly site power and cooling, not only GPUs. DSX Ready is a vendor-alignment program; it does not itself add compute capacity.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 前沿訓練的瓶頸愈來愈是場址電力與冷卻，而不只是 GPU。DSX Ready 是供應商對齊計畫，本身不增加算力。
frontier_other.quote: To help builders make those decisions, NVIDIA is introducing NVIDIA DSX Ready, a qualification program for partner products and solutions that meet applicable NVIDIA DSX AI factory reference design requirements.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 為協助建置方做決策，NVIDIA 推出 DSX Ready，認證符合 NVIDIA DSX AI 工廠參考設計要求的夥伴產品與方案。

brief_en: No new flagship models in the last 12 hours. Reuters: OpenAI and Anthropic asked Australia to ease a training-copyright ban. Press: the labs weighed a mutual API stress-test pact. Carry-over: SpaceXAI’s Grok 4.7, OpenAI’s IAS math group, NVIDIA DSX Ready, and partner rollouts of Claude.
brief_zh: 近12小時無新旗艦模型。路透：OpenAI與Anthropic籲澳洲放寬訓練著作權禁令；媒體稱兩實驗室曾談互相壓力測試。延續：Grok 4.7、OpenAI數學顧問團、NVIDIA DSX Ready與Claude夥伴通路。
